outcome: facilitation of exteriorization of the gravid uterus
identification of the exact site of placental implantation
minimization of placental separation and uncontrolled blood loss
cohort: Five pregnant women with abnormally invasive placenta (AIP) of the anterior uterine wall
finding: Pre-cesarean amnion drainage combined with a transverse laparotomy facilitated exteriorization of the gravid uterus in women with AIP, potentially improving surgical management.
